media.method_note: HEAD metadata requests only for audio, original covers, generated covers and fonts. One latest Kenny Hoopla MP3 GET requests bytes0-255 and reads at most256 bytes, even if the server ignores Range. No complete audio/mix or image bodies downloaded.
limitations: HEAD metadata and a short byte range verify endpoint availability/headers, not complete decoding or full-track playback.
CORS header observations are for the supplied GitHub Pages Origin header and may differ without Origin.
Spaces in media URL paths were percent-encoded; surrounding source whitespace was trimmed.

runtime: Audio, covers, fonts and four playback SVG icons remain externally hosted. No complete music file was copied into this repository. Native HTMLAudioElement does not set crossOrigin or require fetch/AudioContext CORS access.
